embeds.title: 🕯️ Dates are a scene now
embeds.description: Take your crush, partner or spouse out and actually be on the date. Every action raises (or dents) the spark. Romantic dates only.

embeds.title: 🍝 Every venue is different
embeds.description: Restaurant (wine, footsie, shared dessert), movies (popcorn, an arm around the shoulder), gala (slow dance, champagne, the balcony), concert, park, arcade, beach, picnic, mini-golf, or cooking dinner at home.

embeds.title: 💋 Moments
embeds.description: As the spark rises: hold hands, kiss, French kiss — then back to your place, or sneaking off to the restroom if they're really in love. Sometimes they suggest it. Condom or not is your call. Adults with Mature Content on, and not too drunk.
